items.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock with Competitive Advantages and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: Many investors pay attention to mid-cap stocks because they have established business models and expansive market opportunities. However, their paths to becoming $100 billion corporations are ripe with competition, ranging from giants with vast resources to agile upstarts eager to disrupt the status quo.

items.title: 3 Cash-Producing Stocks We Steer Clear Of
items.summary: Generating cash is essential for any business, but not all cash-rich companies are great investments. Some produce plenty of cash but fail to allocate it effectively, leading to missed opportunities.

items.title: 1 Industrials Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 We Avoid
items.summary: Even if they go mostly unnoticed, industrial businesses are the backbone of our country. Unfortunately, this role also comes with a demand profile tethered to the ebbs and flows of the broader economy, and investors seem to be forecasting a downturn - over the past six months, the industry has pulled back by 1.5%. This performance is a noticeable divergence from the S&P 500’s 11.6% return.
